newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April-June capital spending up 7.3 pct -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan April-June capital spending up 7.3 pct -- MOF.

text.p: Japanese companies boosted spending on plant and equipment by 7.3 percent in the April-June quarter from the same period last year, a survey by the Ministry of Finance (MOF) showed on Wednesday.
This compared with 7.5 percent year-on-year growth in capital spending in the January-March period.

The quarterly survey of 839,315 companies also showed corporate current profits increased 34.4 percent in the April-June quarter from a year earlier, compared with year-on-year growth of 25.4 percent in the previous quarter, the ministry said.

For the year to March 1996, corporate capital spending grew 3.9 percent year-on-year after three straight years of declines, while corporate profits increased 20.2 percent after a rise of 6.4 percent in 1994/95, the ministry's corporate survey showed.
